description: This file defines the TransactionService interface, which extends a generic service interface for handling Transaction entities. It declares methods for retrieving capturable and refundable transactions related to orders, as well as listing transactions for a specific order.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: An interface extending generic entity service with methods specific to payment transactions, including retrieving capturable, refundable, and listing transactions associated with orders.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a previous transaction of type 'authorize' for a given order, indicating a transaction that can be captured.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction associated with the order that is eligible for refund.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions associated with the specified order.
